title: Learning to Defer under Expert Drift
title_zh: 专家可靠性漂移下的决策移交学习（Learning to Defer）
abstract_en: The learning to defer (L2D) framework enables safety in machine learning and AI systems by allocating difficult or critical decisions to a human expert. However, most prior work on L2D assumes fixed expert reliability, overlooking temporal fluctuations in human performance due to factors such as fatigue and cognitive biases. Humans commonly exhibit such substantial, systematic performance shifts across a wide range of domains, from high-stakes settings such as radiology, aviation, and judicial decision-making, to everyday tasks such as crowdsourced image annotation. We propose Expert-Drift-Adapted Learning-to-Defer (EDA-L2D), a novel expert-aware L2D framework that explicitly models these temporal shifts by conditioning the deferral head on recent histories of expert outcomes via a sequence model. This history-aware approach enables adaptive deferral policies that anticipate reliability fluctuations and better allocate decisions between human and machine over time. We provide comprehensive experiments across three diverse tasks -- image classification, medical diagnosis, and hate speech detection -- including generalization analyses under realistic deferral conditions and irregular shifts in expert reliability. Our results show that EDA-L2D adapts more effectively than prior L2D methods to diverse temporal patterns of expert reliability, resulting in improved system performance and more effective deferral decisions. Code is available at https://github.com/ZiyaoMou/L2D-Expert-Drift.
abstract_zh: 决策移交学习（Learning to Defer, L2D）让模型将困难或关键的决策交给人类专家。然而，多数既有方法假设专家的可靠性恒定，忽视了疲劳和认知偏差等因素引起的表现波动。本文提出 Expert-Drift-Adapted Learning-to-Defer（EDA-L2D），利用序列模型编码专家近期的决策结果，并将其作为移交决策头的输入，使系统能够预判专家可靠性的变化，动态决定由模型还是专家处理当前样本。作者在图像分类、医学诊断和仇恨言论检测三项任务上开展实验，并在贴近实际的移交条件和专家可靠性不规则变化的情形下评估泛化能力。结果表明，相比以往的 L2D 方法，EDA-L2D 能更好地适应不同的可靠性变化模式，改善移交决策和系统整体表现。
key_points_zh: 传统 L2D 通常假设专家可靠性恒定，难以应对专家表现随时间变化的情形。
EDA-L2D 将专家近期的决策结果输入序列模型，以历史信息指导当前的移交决策。
实验覆盖图像分类、医学诊断和仇恨言论检测，并考察贴近实际的移交条件和不规则漂移下的泛化能力。
相较以往的 L2D 方法，EDA-L2D 更能适应多种可靠性变化模式，并提升人机协作系统的整体表现。
